theme: 指数时间窗口涨跌幅排名与聚合·主题指数年内表现盘点

initial.question: 中证军工指数今年以来涨跌幅是多少？
initial.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND((e.TCLOSE/b.TCLOSE-1)*100,2) AS ytd_pct FROM GET_INDX_GEN_INFO g JOIN INDX_MKT b ON b.INNER_CODE=g.INNER_CODE JOIN INDX_MKT e ON e.INNER_CODE=g.INNER_CODE WHERE g.INDX_CNAME='中证军工指数' AND g.ISVALID=1 AND b.ISVALID=1 AND e.ISVALID=1 AND b.TRADEDATE=(SELECT MAX(TRADEDATE) FROM INDX_MKT WHERE INNER_CODE=g.INNER_CODE AND ISVALID=1 AND TRADEDATE<'2026-01-01') AND e.TRADEDATE=(SELECT MAX(TRADEDATE) FROM INDX_MKT WHERE INNER_CODE=g.INNER_CODE AND ISVALID=1)

feedbacks.question: 同样的时间区间，中证银行指数表现怎么样？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND((e.TCLOSE/b.TCLOSE-1)*100,2) AS ytd_pct FROM GET_INDX_GEN_INFO g JOIN INDX_MKT b ON b.INNER_CODE=g.INNER_CODE JOIN INDX_MKT e ON e.INNER_CODE=g.INNER_CODE WHERE g.INDX_CNAME='中证银行指数' AND g.ISVALID=1 AND b.ISVALID=1 AND e.ISVALID=1 AND b.TRADEDATE=(SELECT MAX(TRADEDATE) FROM INDX_MKT WHERE INNER_CODE=g.INNER_CODE AND ISVALID=1 AND TRADEDATE<'2026-01-01') AND e.TRADEDATE=(SELECT MAX(TRADEDATE) FROM INDX_MKT WHERE INNER_CODE=g.INNER_CODE AND ISVALID=1)

feedbacks.question: 那中证军工2025年全年涨了多少？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND((e.TCLOSE/b.TCLOSE-1)*100,2) AS pct_2025 FROM GET_INDX_GEN_INFO g JOIN INDX_MKT b ON b.INNER_CODE=g.INNER_CODE JOIN INDX_MKT e ON e.INNER_CODE=g.INNER_CODE WHERE g.INDX_CNAME='中证军工指数' AND g.ISVALID=1 AND b.ISVALID=1 AND e.ISVALID=1 AND b.TRADEDATE=(SELECT MAX(TRADEDATE) FROM INDX_MKT WHERE INNER_CODE=g.INNER_CODE AND ISVALID=1 AND TRADEDATE<'2025-01-01') AND e.TRADEDATE=(SELECT MAX(TRADEDATE) FROM INDX_MKT WHERE INNER_CODE=g.INNER_CODE AND ISVALID=1 AND TRADEDATE<'2026-01-01')

feedbacks.question: 今年以来它的日均成交额大概什么量级？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(TVALUE)/100000000,2) AS avg_amt_yi FROM INDX_MKT WHERE ISVALID=1 AND TRADEDATE>='2026-01-01' AND INNER_CODE=(SELECT INNER_CODE FROM GET_INDX_GEN_INFO WHERE INDX_CNAME='中证军工指数' AND ISVALID=1)

feedbacks.question: 再看个短线问题，9月2日上证50、中证白酒、中证医疗这三个指数谁的日涨幅最大？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT INNER_CODE, INDX_SNAME, CHNG_PCT FROM INDX_MKT WHERE ISVALID=1 AND INNER_CODE IN (106000255,106006657,106006473) AND TRADEDATE='2026-09-02' ORDER BY CHNG_PCT DESC

feedbacks.question: 把这三个指数今年以来涨跌幅从高到低排一下，谁最抗跌？
feedbacks.gold_display: 中证医疗 -1.18% > 上证50 -3.85% > 中证白酒 -26.11%，中证医疗最抗跌
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT g.INDX_CNAME, ROUND((e.TCLOSE/b.TCLOSE-1)*100,2) AS ytd_pct FROM GET_INDX_GEN_INFO g JOIN INDX_MKT b ON b.INNER_CODE=g.INNER_CODE JOIN INDX_MKT e ON e.INNER_CODE=g.INNER_CODE WHERE g.INDX_CNAME IN ('中证医疗指数','上证50指数','中证白酒指数') AND g.ISVALID=1 AND b.ISVALID=1 AND e.ISVALID=1 AND b.TRADEDATE=(SELECT MAX(TRADEDATE) FROM INDX_MKT WHERE INNER_CODE=g.INNER_CODE AND ISVALID=1 AND TRADEDATE<'2026-01-01') AND e.TRADEDATE=(SELECT MAX(TRADEDATE) FROM INDX_MKT WHERE INNER_CODE=g.INNER_CODE AND ISVALID=1) ORDER BY ytd_pct DESC
